item.title: Mohamed Bakarr
item.description: Dr Mohamed Bakarr is a Manager for the Integration and Knowledge Division. He oversees knowledge management and learning for the GEF, as well as all programming to advance holistic and integrated approaches for tackling global environmental challenges.

item.title: Chizuru Aoki
item.description: Chizuru heads the GEF Division of Multilateral Environmental Agreements (MEAs) and Funds, and is a member of the GEF’s Leadership Team. She oversees the GEF’s work with six MEAs as their financial mechanisms, through strategy development, programming, governance support, and resource mobilization.

item.title: Sonja Sabita Teelucksingh
item.description: Sonja Sabita Teelucksingh Adviser to the Interim CEO and Lead, Data and Analytics Division, GEF

item.title: Peter Lallas
item.description: Peter Lallas joined the GEF Secretariat in March 2014 as Adviser to the GEF CEO, and serves as General Manager and Conflict Resolution Commissioner.

item.title: Claude Gascon
item.description: Claude Gascon was appointed as interim CEO by the GEF Council during its 70th session in December 2025. He also serves as the Director of Strategy and Operations, bringing extensive experience in conservation leadership and scientific research. From 2010 to 2015, he served as Chief Science Officer and Executive Vice President at the National Fish & Wildlife Foundation, where he played a key role in advancing the organization’s mission.

item.title: Robert Bisset
item.description: Robert Bisset Head of Communications, GEF

item.title: Jonathan Caldicott
item.description: Jonathan is the Manager of the Operations and Policy Division at the Global Environment Facility Secretariat, overseeing a team of professionals responsible for project and program reviews, portfolio operations and management, results monitoring and reporting, and the development and upkeep of GEF operational policies and guidelines.

item.title: Carlos Manuel Rodríguez
item.description: Lawyer by profession, politician by choice, and conservationist at heart, Carlos Manuel Rodríguez served as CEO and Chairperson of the Global Environment Facility from June 2020 to December 2025.

item.title: Adriana Goncalves Moreira
item.description: A Brazilian national, Dr. Adriana Gonçalves Moreira is an expert in biodiversity conservation, climate change, and environmental sustainability. She is currently the head of the Global Environment Facility Partnerships Division. Previously, she was Regional Coordinator for Latin America and also lead of the Global Wildlife Program (GWP), which includes projects in 32 countries in Africa, Asia, and Latin America at the GEF Secretariat.

item.title: Fred Boltz
item.description: Dr. Fred Boltz is Head of Programming at the Global Environment Facility. In this role, Fred oversees programming of GEF grant resources to 150+ recipient countries to support their pursuit of environmental goals under commitments to six UN Conventions.
